messages:
elaine: quick question — thinking about splitting policy eval into two passes: a tiny deterministic fast-match path for SLO-sensitive routing, and a richer async score-refine. anyone see obvious pitfalls?
raj: sounds reasonable. fast-match should only use indexable attrs (region, tenant-tier, model-compat). keep cost/latency weights in the refine. main risk is stale refine results causing thrash.
sam: if refine is async we need a hard fallback budget. i.e. if refine takes >10ms return fast-match result and then let refine update cache for next request. also need deterministic tie-breaker so clients see stable behavior.
marta: current tie-breaker (shard id) creates hot spots. proposal: use stable hash of (tenant_id, route_key) as secondary tie-breaker + rotate salt on version bump.
elaine: sketch of the fast-match config we could expose to infra teams:
```
fast_match: 
  index_keys: [region, tenant_tier, model_family]
  ttl_ms: 1000
  fallback_timeout_ms: 10
  tie_breaker: stable_hash
```
raj: telemetry we need: fast_path_hit, fast_path_miss, refine_latency_ms, fallback_rate, stale_refine_updates. plus per-tenant counters for unfairness detection.
sam: cache invalidation is hard. suggest versioned keys for the index and lazy invalidate on policy hotreload. i.e. new version -> write new prefix, old requests naturally expire.
marta: operational question — do we need a new store for the fast index? can we reuse existing redis cluster or is a custom memstore (rocksdb in-process) better for latency?
elaine: prefer reusing redis for now (we already have cluster + HA). memstore faster but increases complexity for state sync. we can prototype memstore as optional adapter.
raj: to be conservative, quantify targets: aim for fast_path_resolve >= 90% of requests <1ms and tail p99 latency improvement by 30% on noisy models. need sim harness to validate.
sam: i'll pick up the fallback/budget guard impl and ensure deterministic tie-breaker code + tests.
marta: i'll own RFC follow-up and perf sim. plan: generate traffic mix with hot tenants and model shifts, measure fast/refine metrics. ETA: EOD Wed.
elaine: action items: 
- marta: perf sim + RFC follow-up
- raj: telemetry schema + dashboards
- sam: fallback guard + tie-breaker impl + tests
- elaine: service adapter PR + memstore adapter spike
@oncall-bot please tag design-sync-needed so PM/ops can join review.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: policy-fastmatch-adapter v0.1 -> staging (CI green).
